a <- read_csv("C:/Users/jaeminkim/OneDrive - oakland.edu/프로구단 전략 통계학/data/3_walmart_data/walmart_cleaned.csv") # 파일이 있는 폴더로 변경하세요!!!

## ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
b    <- a[a$Dept == 19, ]
a_ts <- ts(b$Weekly_Sales, start = c(2010, 6), end = c(2012, 43), freq = 52)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────
# 2. 시계열 구성요소 시각화 (STL)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────
plot(a_ts,
     xlab = "시간",
     ylab = "주간매출")

plot(stl(a_ts, s.window = "periodic"),
     main = NULL,
     labels = c("데이터", "계절성", "추세", "오차"))

# ─────────────────────────────────────────
# 3. 학습/검증 분할 (70:30)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────
n       <- length(a_ts)
train_n <- floor(0.7 * n)
valid_n <- n - train_n

train_df   <- window(a_ts, end   = time(a_ts)[train_n])
valid_df   <- window(a_ts, start = time(a_ts)[train_n + 1])
split_time <- time(a_ts)[train_n]

# ─────────────────────────────────────────
# 4. ggplot2 시각화 함수 정의
# ─────────────────────────────────────────
plot_forecast <- function(a_ts, fcast, model_name, split_time) {
  
  df_actual   <- data.frame(time  = as.numeric(time(a_ts)),
                            value = as.numeric(a_ts),
                            type  = "실제값")
  df_fitted   <- data.frame(time  = as.numeric(time(fcast$fitted)),
                            value = as.numeric(fcast$fitted),
                            type  = "적합값 (학습)")
  df_forecast <- data.frame(time  = as.numeric(time(fcast$mean)),
                            value = as.numeric(fcast$mean),
                            type  = "예측값 (검증)")
  df_ci       <- data.frame(time  = as.numeric(time(fcast$mean)),
                            lower = as.numeric(fcast$lower),
                            upper = as.numeric(fcast$upper))
  df_plot <- bind_rows(df_actual, df_fitted, df_forecast)
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(data = df_ci,
                aes(x = time, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_line(data = df_plot,
              aes(x = time, y = value,
                  color = type, linetype = type, linewidth = type)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = split_time,
               linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = split_time - 0.3, y = max(df_plot$value) * 0.15,
             label = "학습", size = 3.5, hjust = 1) +
    annotate("text", x = split_time + 0.1, y = max(df_plot$value) * 0.15,
             label = "검증", size = 3.5, hjust = 0) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("실제값"        = "black",
                                  "적합값 (학습)" = "gray40",
                                  "예측값 (검증)" = "gray20")) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("실제값"        = "solid",
                                     "적합값 (학습)" = "solid",
                                     "예측값 (검증)" = "dashed")) +
    scale_linewidth_manual(values = c("실제값"        = 0.7,
                                      "적합값 (학습)" = 1.0,
                                      "예측값 (검증)" = 1.0)) +
    labs(title    = paste0(model_name, ": 학습 / 검증 / 예측"),
         x = "시간", y = "주간 판매",
         color = NULL, linetype = NULL, linewidth = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}



# ─────────────────────────────────────────
# 6. 기본 tslm 모델 3종: summary → 시각화 → 누적
# ─────────────────────────────────────────
model_specs <- list(
  "선형 트렌드"          = train_df ~ trend,
  "이차 트렌드"          = train_df ~ trend + I(trend^2),
  "선형 트렌드 + 계절성"  = train_df ~ trend + season
)

accuracy_tbl <- list()

for (model_name in names(model_specs)) {
  
  cat("\n\n========================================\n")
  cat("  모델:", model_name, "\n")
  cat("========================================\n")
  
  fit   <- tslm(model_specs[[model_name]])
  fcast <- forecast(fit, h = length(valid_df), level = 95)
  
  # (1) summary
  print(summary(fit))
  
  # (2) 시각화
  print(plot_forecast(a_ts, fcast, model_name, split_time))
  
  # 성능 누적
  acc <- accuracy(fcast, valid_df) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(Model = model_name, Set = rownames(.))
  accuracy_tbl[[model_name]] <- acc
}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────
# 5. Fourier 항 생성 함수 (재사용 편의용)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────
make_fourier_xreg <- function(trend_idx, K = 3, period = 52) {
  mat <- do.call(cbind, lapply(1:K, function(k) {
    cbind(
      sin(2 * pi * k * trend_idx / period),
      cos(2 * pi * k * trend_idx / period)
    )
  }))
  colnames(mat) <- c(outer(1:K, c("sin", "cos"),
                           function(k, f) paste0(f, k)))
  as.data.frame(mat)
}

fourier_train <- make_fourier_xreg(1:train_n)
# tslm은 data= 인자 미지원 → 변수를 직접 환경에 선언
trend  <- 1:train_n
sin1   <- fourier_train$sin1;  cos1 <- fourier_train$cos1
sin2   <- fourier_train$sin2;  cos2 <- fourier_train$cos2
sin3   <- fourier_train$sin3;  cos3 <- fourier_train$cos3

a_fourier <- tslm(train_df ~ trend + sin1 + cos1 + sin2 + cos2 + sin3 + cos3)

# 검증용 Fourier 항 생성
fourier_valid <- make_fourier_xreg((train_n + 1):(train_n + valid_n))
newdata_valid <- data.frame(
  trend = (train_n + 1):(train_n + valid_n),
  sin1  = fourier_valid$sin1,  cos1 = fourier_valid$cos1,
  sin2  = fourier_valid$sin2,  cos2 = fourier_valid$cos2,
  sin3  = fourier_valid$sin3,  cos3 = fourier_valid$cos3
)

a_fourier_valid <- forecast(a_fourier, newdata = newdata_valid, level = 95)
# (1) summary
print(summary(a_fourier))

# 11. 미래 5기간 예측 (전체 데이터로 재학습 후 예측)

cat("\n\n========================================\n")

##   미래 5기간 예측

## ========================================
h_pred      <- 5
total_n     <- n
pred_idx    <- (total_n + 1):(total_n + h_pred)

# 전체 데이터로 ARIMA 재학습
xreg_full   <- cbind(trend = 1:total_n,
                     make_fourier_xreg(1:total_n))
a_arima_full <- auto.arima(a_ts, xreg = as.matrix(xreg_full), seasonal = FALSE)

# 예측용 xreg
xreg_pred   <- cbind(trend = pred_idx,
                     make_fourier_xreg(pred_idx))

a_arima_pred <- forecast(a_arima_full,
                         xreg  = as.matrix(xreg_pred),
                         h     = h_pred,
                         level = 95)

# 예측 결과 테이블
pred_df <- as.data.frame(a_arima_pred) %>%
  mutate(기간 = 1:h_pred) %>%
  select(기간, everything())
rownames(pred_df) <- NULL

cat("\n[ 미래 5기간 예측 결과 ]\n")
## 
## [ 미래 5기간 예측 결과 ]
print(pred_df)
##   기간 Point Forecast    Lo 95    Hi 95
## 1    1      1173.3911 601.0949 1745.687
## 2    2      1132.5468 538.4320 1726.662
## 3    3      1077.2489 448.5069 1705.991
## 4    4      1043.7538 401.9117 1685.596
## 5    5       997.8214 355.9793 1639.664
# 예측 시각화 (전체 + 미래 5기간)
df_full    <- data.frame(time  = as.numeric(time(a_ts)),
                         value = as.numeric(a_ts), type = "실제값")
df_pred    <- data.frame(time  = as.numeric(time(a_arima_pred$mean)),
                         value = as.numeric(a_arima_pred$mean), type = "미래 예측")
df_ci_pred <- data.frame(time  = as.numeric(time(a_arima_pred$mean)),
                         lower = as.numeric(a_arima_pred$lower),
                         upper = as.numeric(a_arima_pred$upper))

ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = df_ci_pred,
              aes(x = time, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
              fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = bind_rows(df_full, df_pred),
            aes(x = time, y = value, color = type,
                linetype = type, linewidth = type)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = max(as.numeric(time(a_ts))),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
  annotate("text",
           x = max(as.numeric(time(a_ts))) + 0.05,
           y = max(df_full$value) * 0.15,
           label = "예측 시작", size = 3.5, hjust = 0) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("실제값" = "black", "미래 예측" = "gray30")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("실제값" = "solid", "미래 예측" = "dashed")) +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = c("실제값" = 0.7, "미래 예측" = 1.0)) +
  labs(title    = "Fourier + ARIMA: 미래 5기간 예측",
       x = "시간", y = "주간 판매",
       color = NULL, linetype = NULL, linewidth = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
